name: CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo
description: Meridian Claims: a real multi-agent health-insurance claims-adjudication system (CrewAI + MCP + Langfuse) demonstrating production-grade LLM observability

paragraphs: A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system built to demonstrate what production-grade multi-agent observability actually looks like — not a toy example. Three CrewAI agents (Policy Verification, Medical History, Fraud/Exception) call tools through MCP, a deterministic decision gate approves/denies/routes each claim, and every step — every LLM call, every tool call, every score — is traced live in Langfuse Cloud. No mocks pretending to be a product, no Docker required. Full design/rationale: PRD.md.
Topics: llm-observability multi-agent-systems ai-agents crewai langfuse mcp model-context-protocol fastapi nextjs llmops agentic-ai enterprise-ai python typescript
